tasks.label: ANKA: BIST Dashboard
tasks.command: PYTHONUTF8=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python -X utf8 -m streamlit run app.py --server.port 8501 --server.headless true

tasks.label: ANKA: Muhendis Canli mi?
tasks.detail: data/muhendis_heartbeat.json'i okur — son atim ne zaman?
tasks.command: if [ -f data/muhendis_heartbeat.json ]; then echo '🦅 Muhendis heartbeat:'; cat data/muhendis_heartbeat.json; echo; python3 -c "import json,datetime as d; h=json.load(open('data/muhendis_heartbeat.json')); t=d.datetime.fromisoformat(h['zaman']); diff=(d.datetime.now()-t).total_seconds(); print(f'⏱  Son atim: {int(diff)} saniye once ({\"CANLI\" if diff<180 else \"OLU/DURMUS\"})')"; else echo '❌ Heartbeat dosyasi yok — muhendis hic calismamis veya yeni surum henuz yuklenmemis.'; fi

tasks.label: ANKA: VPS SSH Test
tasks.command: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; sshpass -p "$VPS_PASSWORD" ssh -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no "${VPS_USER:-Administrator}@${VPS_HOST:-78.135.87.29}" "hostname && echo SSH_OK"
